title: THE ORGANIZATION AND FUNCTIONING OF THE CAMBODIA HALAL STEERING COMMITTEE - CHSC
text:
Unofficial Translation
KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA
NATION RELIGION KING
Royal Government of Cambodia
No. 160 ANK/BK
SUB-DECREE
ON
THE ORGANIZATION AND FUNCTIONING
OF THE CAMBODIA HALAL STEERING COMMITTEE - CHSC
Royal Government
- Having seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0913/903 dated 24 September 2013 on the
Appointment of the Royal Government of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/1213/1393 dated 21 December 2013 on the
Reshuffling and Supplementation of Composition of the Royal Government of the Kingdom of
Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. 02/NS/94 dated 20 July 1994 promulgating the Law on the
Organization and the Functioning of the Council of Ministers
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/16 dated 24 January 1996 promulgating the Law
on the Establishment of the Ministry of Commerce
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No. 131 ANK/BK dated 19 March 2014 on the Organization and
Functioning of the Ministry of Commerce
- According to the necessity of the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia
DECIDES
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1. _
To establish the Cambodia Halal Steering Committee with the acronym of “CHSC” in order to
manage, inspect, and issue the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard for the purpose
of promoting technical standard, hygiene, and the trust of Muslims towards the Cambodian Halal Products
supplying in local markets and promoting exports to international markets.
Article 2. _
The following key terms used under this sub-degree shall have the meaning as defined hereunder:
- “ ” or “HALAL” or “للاح” (an Arabic Word) refers to any object or service which is per-
ហាឡាល
missible to use or engage in according to Islamic law. These terms are commonly used in relation
to food products, meat products, cosmetics, personal care products, pharmaceuticals, nutrition,
food ingredients, and other consumables.

- Product refers to the general category of goods such as groceries, foods, and services that serve
customer's need or want.
- Halal Products refers to products which occur naturally or are produced according to the technical
standard of Halal Products that do not contradict to the provisions of Islamic Law.
- Cambodian Halal Products refers to services, production, and packaging of the Halal Products in
Cambodia.
- Service refers to the acceptance of works, authorization, permission to use or for any profit or deed
by asking for dividends or other benefits that do not include recruitment under labor law.
- Production refers to processing, blending, mixing, assembling, creating, or transforming images
including formatting, resizing, distribution, packaging, or storage.
- Packaging refers to packaging the finished Halal products according to technical standards of
Cambodian Halal products.
- President of the Highest Council for Islamic Religious Affairs of Cambodia refers to the Pres-
ident of the Highest Council for Islamic Religious Affairs in Cambodia that are appointed by His
Majesty the King of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
CHAPTER II
COMPOSITION OF THE CHSC
Article 3. _
The CHSC composes of the following members:
- Minister of Commerce Chairman
- Secretary of State of the Ministry of Commerce 01 person Vice Chairman
- Senior of Muslim Leader 01 person Vice Chairman
- Member of the Council of Jurists of Office of the Council of
Ministers 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Interior 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Justice 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and
International Cooperation 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Labor and Vocational Training 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Economic and Finance 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and
Fisheries 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Industryand Handicraft 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Cult and Religion 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Health 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Tourism 01 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Information 01 person Member
- Director General of the Camcontrol of the Ministry of Commerce 01 person Member
- Representative of the Cambodian Highest Council for
Islamic Religious Affairs 01 person Member
The actual composition shall be appointed by the decision of the Royal Government.

CHAPTER III
ROLES, DUTIES AND FUNCTIONING OF THE CHSC
Article 4. _
The CHSC shall have the following roles and duties:
- To conduct research, prepare, compile, legalize all documents related to halal, and monitor
the progress of the Cambodian Halal Affairs;
- To systemize the management of the Cambodian Halal Products, especially the examination
of Halal Products for supplying local markets and promoting export, as well as for protecting
the Cambodian Halal Logo;
- To approve the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard;
- To act as a coordinator in building partnerships with the public and private sectors;
- To advise the government on all issues related to the development of halal products in
Cambodia;
- To research and develop the whole Halal production chain;
- To attract foreign assistance for supporting the Cambodian Halal Products;
- To act as the information center and consultant to investors intending to develop Halal
products in the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- To examine and monitor all projects related to the Cambodian Halal Products
- To attend national and international meetings and conferences on the development of Global
halal products;
- To prepare any reports and to regularly advise the Government about any updates and
progress of the Cambodian Halal Products as well as foreign market information for the
Royal Government of Cambodia.
- To act as the coordinator in all work related to the Cambodian Halal Affairs; and
- To carry out other relevant work as assigned by the Government.
Article 5. _
The CHSC shall hold at least two meetings per year. If deemed necessary, the CHSC may call for
extraordinary meetings.
The CHSC members shall attend the meeting as being invited by the Chairman. The Chairman may
delegate the authority to the Vice-Chairman to chair the meeting as delegated by the Chairman.

If deemed necessary, the Chairman of the CHSC may invite representatives from relevant
ministries, institutions, experts, national and international organizations and private sector to the meeting
to give opinions.
The CHSC may have some technical advisors and national and international experts as needed.
The CHSC has the right to use the seal of the Ministry of Commerce.
Article 6. _
The CHSC has a secretariat, the Department of Trade Policy of the Ministry of Commerce, as an
implementing body.
The Organization and Functioning of The CHSC Secretariat shall be determined by Prakas of the
Minister of Commerce.
CHAPTER IV
THE CAMBODIA HALAL TECHNICAL WORKING GROUP
Article 7. _
To establish Halal Technical Working Group under the CHSC Secretariat which is responsible for
providing Halal product advice to the CHSC to review technical standards, monitor the provision of
services, production or packaging of the Cambodian Halal Products, and issue the Certificate of Cambodia
Halal Product Technical Standard approved by Minister of Commerce, who is acting as Chairman of the
CHSC.
Article 8. _
Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group is led by the President of the Highest Council for Islamic
Religious Affairs of Cambodia. The actual composition shall be appointed by Prakas of the Minister of
Commerce, who is acting as the Chairman of the CHSC.
Article 9. _
The Organization and Functioning of the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group shall be
defined by Prakas of the Minister of Commerce, who is acting as Chairman of the CHSC.
CHAPTER V
THE EXAMINATION AND ISSUANCE OF THE CERTIFICATE OF CAMBODIA HALAL
PRODUCT TECHNICAL STANDARD
Article 10. _
A natural person or legal entity who intends to provide services, production, and packaging of
products marked or labeled “ ” or “HALAL” or “للاح” in the Kingdom of Cambodia must first file
ហាឡាល
an application form for the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard at the Ministry of
Commerce.
Without the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard, the provision of services,

production, or packaging of products marked or labeled “ ” or “HALAL” or “للاح” in the Kingdom
ហាឡាល
of Cambodia, with or without the intention of doing business, shall be prohibited.
Article 11. _
A natural person or legal entity who provides services, production, and packaging of certified Halal
products from another country must first file the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard
application form at the Ministry of Commerce.
The provision of services, production, or packaging of certified halal products from another country
marked or labeled “ ” or “HALAL” or “للاح”, without the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product
ហាឡាល
Technical Standard, shall be prohibited.
Article 12. _
After receiving an application form, the CHSC shall cooperate with the Cambodia Halal Technical
Working Group to carry out on-site inspection at the provision of services, production, packaging, and other
relevant locations in order to inspect raw materials or products to be packaged, processing of service,
production, packaging and storage.
The procedure of application for the assessment of halal product technical standard shall be
determined by Prakas of the Minister of Commerce, who is acting as the Chairman of the CHSC.
Article 13. _
Once the provision of service, production, packaging of product has satisfied the quality assessment
requirements of halal products, the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard will be issued
within 3 months by the CHSC and the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group. The Certificate of
Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard shall be issued by Halal Technical Working Group and
approved by the Minister of Commerce, who is acting as the Chairman of the CHSC.
Article 14. _
After Consultation with the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group, the assessment
requirements of halal product technical standard shall be determined by Prakas of the Minister of
Commerce, who is acting as the Chairman of the CHSC.
After Consultation with the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group, the logo, template and
validity period of the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard shall be determined by
Prakas of the Minister of Commerce, who is acting as the Chairman of the CHSC.
Application fee, issuance fee, and administrative fee for the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product
Technical Standard shall be determined by Joint Prakas of the Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of
Economics and Finance.
Article 15. _
The CHSC has the right to assign officials and Halal Experts to carry out on-site inspection at the
provision of services, production, packaging and other relevant locations in order to inspect halal product
technical standard. In case any non-compliance to the assessment requirements of halal products technical

standard have been found and have been made by service provider, producer, packaging maker, after
consultation with the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group, the CHSC will either decide as follows:
- Request to take corrective action
- Revoke the logo of the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard from the
products
- Suspend the use of the logo of the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard
for a while until the corrective action has been made successfully.
- Completely revoke the logo and the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard
from the products.
The inspection of Halal Product Technical Standard by the CHSC is not an obstacle to the
supervision of other authorities that carry out their legal mandate's duties. The product owners are still
obliged to comply with technical standards, hygiene and environment, following the provision in force.
Article 16. _
The CHSC cooperates with CAMCONTROL Directorate-General to assign officials to inspect
the use of halal logo and the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard on halal imported
products at products warehouse, or products circulating in the market, or service locations.
CAMCONTROL Directorate-General shall assign officials to inspect the use of halal logo and the
Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard on halal imported products at products
warehouse, or products circulating in the market, or service locations.
CHAPTER VI
RESOURCES OF THE CHSC
Article 17. _
The CHSC has national budget sources which is included in the package of annual budget of the
Ministry of Commerce. The CHSC shall create a bank account at the National Treasury.
According to the procedure in force, the CHSC has the right to receive and manage funds from
other sources for its functioning.
The CHSC shall prepare financial reports to the Ministry of Economy and Finance on sources of
funds from international cooperation, development partners, and other sources that serve its functioning.
CHAPTER VII
PENALTIES
Article 18. _
Sanction under this sub-decree includes as following:
– Written warnings
– Suspension or revocation of the Logo of the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical
Standard from the products.
– Suspension or revocation of the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard.
– Provisional Fines.

The above sanctions are the competency of the Minister of Commerce, who is acting as the
Chairman of the CHSC.
A person who is not satisfied with the decision of the Minister of Commerce may appeal to a
competent court, except provisional fines.
The procedure for provisional fine, the payment of fines, the management of fines payment receipt,
and the management of income from provisional fine as stated in provision of this sub-decree must be
prescribed in an Inter-Ministerial Prakas between the Minister of Commerce, the Minister of Economic and
Finance, and the Minister of Justice.
Article 19. _
The payment of provisional fine shall lead to termination of criminal actions.
In case the offender refuses to pay the provisional fine, the Minister of Commerce shall order the
competent officer of the CAMCONTROL to bring the case of offense to the court following the procedure.
In case of an unknown identity of the offender, the Minister of Commerce shall order the competent
official of the CAMCONTROL to request the competent prosecutor to seize the evidence of the offense.
Relevant stakeholders who object to any decision may appeal to the competent court.
Article 20. _
The Forgery act of the logo or the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard shall
be punished in accordance with the law in force.
Article 21. _
Provision of services, production or packaging of product marked or labeled “ ” or
ហាឡាល
“HALAL” or “ للاح” in the Kingdom of Cambodia without the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product
Technical Standard shall be punished by the provisional fine not exceeding 4,000,000 (four million) Riels,
whether with or without appropriate Halal Certificate received from another Halal Certification Body of
any foreign country.
Punishment shall be doubled if it is violated again within a 2-years period.
Article 22. _
After the suspension or revocation of the logo of the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product
Technical Standard, the act of production, packaging, or services that keep using halal logo on the products
shall be punished by the provisional fine not exceeding 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
Punishment shall be doubled if it is violated again within a 2-years period.
Article 23. _
After expiration, suspension or revocation of the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical
Standard, the act of production, packaging, or services of halal products that keep using halal logo on the
products, shall be punished by the provisional fine not exceeding 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
Punishment shall be doubled if it is violated again within a 2-years period.
Articles 24. _

Legal entity shall be declared criminally liable under conditions as stated in Article 42 (Criminal
Liability of Legal Entities) of the criminal law for offenses as stated in Article 21 to Article 23 of this law.
Legal entity shall be punished by the provisional fine not exceeding 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
Punishment shall be doubled if it is violated again within a 2-years period.
Article 25. _
The act of violations of the assessment requirements of the Cambodian Halal Product Technical
Standard relating to production, packaging, or services of the Cambodian Halal Products shall be punished
by the provisional fine not exceeding 2,000,000 (two million) Riels.
Punishment shall be doubled if it is violated again within a 2-years period.
Article 26. _
Legal entity shall be declared criminally liable under conditions as stated in Article 42 (Criminal
Liability of Legal Entities) of the criminal law for offenses as stated in Article 25 of this law.
Legal entity shall be punished by the provisional fine not exceeding 5,000,000 (five million) Riels.
Punishment shall be doubled if it is violated again within a 2-years period.
Article 27. _
Regardless of other criminal penalties, administrative sanction shall be imposed on any official and
person who has not reported to the CHSC on their authority to inspect halal product technical standard
which found out that the provision of services or production or packaging of halal products marked or
labeled “ ” or “HALAL” “ للاح ” is without the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical
ហាឡាល
Standard, or with an expired or revoked certificate, or by not complying with the assessment requirements
of the Cambodian Halal Product Technical Standard.
Regardless of other criminal penalties, any official and person who carries out inspection on halal
products technical standards without a mission order letter from the CHSC will be subjected to
administrative sanctions.
CHAPTER VIII
TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
Article 28. _
Natural person or legal entity that provides services, production, and packaging of products marked
or labeled “ ” or “HALAL” or “للاح” in the Kingdom of Cambodia shall apply for Certificate of
ហាឡាល
Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard at the Ministry of Commerce within 6 (six) months from the
date of issuance of this Sub-decree. If the natural person or legal entity fails to submit application form for
the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard, it is considered as an illegal product and
faces legal action under this sub-decree.
Natural person or legal entity that provides services, production, and packaging of products marked
or labeled “ ” or “HALAL” or “للاح” in the Kingdom of Cambodia as certified by the Halal
ហាឡាល
Certification Body of any foreign country other than the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall also follow the first

paragraph as stated above.
CHAPTER IX
FINAL PROVISONS
Article 29. _
Any provision contrary to this Sub-Decree shall be abrogated.
Article 30. _
The Minister in-charge of Council of Ministers, the Minister of Economic and Finance, the Minister
of Commerce, the Minister of Justice, all Ministers from relevant ministries, and the President of the
Highest Council for Islamic Religious Affairs of Cambodia shall be responsible for enforcement of this
Sub-Decree from the date of its signing.
Phnom Penh, 29 July 2016
PRIME MINISTER Signed and Sealed
